The *Pañcāyatanakammanibbattapañha* ("The Question on the Deeds that Create the Senses", Mil 3.4.3) is a dialogue situated within the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. The inquiry concerns the relationship between kamma (actions) and the production or generation of the sense bases [SuttaCentral]. The text has been preserved across multiple translations, with four translations in three languages documented on SuttaCentral, including an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].

Regarding parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral notes a curated full parallel in the Chinese canon at T 1670b 2.37 ("The Five Awarenesses Produced by Different Karma") [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus records twenty Pali-internal shared passages with two texts [DharmaNexus]. These include reuse with another discussion in the *Milindapañha*, the *Bhavantasaṅkhārajāyamānapañha* (Mil 3.3.5, especially §0.1–1.2), and an exact alignment with the *Madhura Sutta* (MN 84, where segments §2.1–2.2 share text with MN 84 §5.26–5.27 at a similarity of 1.0) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches scoring 10 or higher [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
